decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system serves a specialist, certification-intensive niche with long product lives and still fits the firm's robust demanding-environment portfolio, so it is more likely to be retained than withdrawn.

The spring-balanced desk lamp supports the firm's ergonomic workplace offer, but as a smaller standalone line outside its core integrated building-lighting focus it faces a higher pruning risk than the main luminaires.
This general interior lighting luminaire sits squarely in the firm's mainstream building-lighting business and remains well aligned with its broad application coverage and established sales channels.
As a flagship pendant luminaire tied to the firm's strategic direction in efficient, high-quality interior lighting, it would be unusual to remove it so soon after launch.

The marine searchlight remains consistent with the firm's specialist harsh-environment offering, and with the HMI variant already removed this line is likely to stay as the focused marine searchlight option.
